name: xingzhi-assistant
description: Open-source local-first desktop assistant for collecting information, advancing tasks and verifying results.
author: lkj110 and contributors

scripts.build: node scripts/build-selection-capture.cjs && node scripts/build-image-ocr.cjs && node scripts/build-pdf-ocr.cjs && vite build
scripts.test: node scripts/build-image-ocr.cjs && node scripts/build-pdf-ocr.cjs && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-packager . 行知助手 --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --asar.unpackDir='desktop/native/bin' --asar.unpack='**/{.**,**}/**/*.node' --icon=desktop/assets/icon.icns --ignore='^/(release[^/]*|tests|scripts|src|artifacts|.local-data)(/|$)' --app-bundle-id=local.xingzhi.assistant
